summary: A symmetrical, multi-tiered Asian-inspired pagoda structure with a rectangular footprint. The building features stacked horizontal roof overhangs in dark material, a central body constructed from wood and stonebrick, decorative gold/brass corner supports, and a central entrance passage. The structure sits on a raised dirt foundation surrounded by grass.

shape.overall_form: Rectangular tower with stacked tiered roofs and central passage

rebuild_hints: Build foundation with stonebrick in rectangular shape approximately 12x12 blocks
Create central hollow passage through middle of structure for entrance
Layer wood horizontally for main walls, alternating with stonebrick bands
Place gold/brass blocks at all four corners as decorative supports
Stack dark slabs in progressively smaller tiers above main body for pagoda roof effect
Ensure bilateral symmetry along both north-south and east-west axes
Add stone trim at base and between material transitions
Top with smallest roof overhang tier
